# conferred by event

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:conferredByEvent`](gmeow-conferredByEvent.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/conferredByEvent>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/names`](../../slices/names.md)

The life event that conferred or changed an appellation — a [`gmeow:LifeEvent`](../classes/gmeow-LifeEvent.md) carrying a [`gmeow:eventType`](gmeow-eventType.md) such as [`gmeow:eventTypeChristening`](../individuals/gmeow-eventTypeChristening.md), [`gmeow:eventTypeNameChange`](../individuals/gmeow-eventTypeNameChange.md), [`gmeow:eventTypeMarriage`](../individuals/gmeow-eventTypeMarriage.md) (a married name), or [`gmeow:eventTypeAdoption`](../individuals/gmeow-eventTypeAdoption.md). Non-functional. The seam joining the names module to the events module's event spine.
